The application of telmisartan in central nervous system disorders. Telmisartan, a well-established antihypertensive drug, has shown promising therapeutic potential for a variety of central nervous system (CNS) disorders. This review outlines the fundamental characteristics of telmisartan, focusing on its dual pharmacological effects as an angiotensin II type 1 receptor (AT1R) antagonist and a peroxisome proliferator-activated receptor (PPAR) γ activator.
